state_omissions.description: External environment loss: the source files and saved goal were missing on resumption after the coordinator host usage interruption. Historical checkpoint/review evidence remains, but current final state is unavailable; no reconstruction or replacement run was performed.

protocol_deviations: Coordinator terminated on an external host usage limit after a passing checkpoint and recorded independent review, before completion. Six days later the temporary live goal/source/home files were absent; current acceptance and final-state verification are unavailable. Row preserved as incomplete without reconstruction.
Initial Python command-wrapper invocation failed with SyntaxError before successful goal creation; corrected invocation and failed output are retained.
Reviewer runtime import check created an excluded __pycache__ directory; independently recomputed checkpoint tree hash remained unchanged.

Full internal role tool histories and consistent three-role usage/cost are unavailable; durable raw lifecycle output, terminal responses and hashed source accounts establish historical observations only.
